title: layout: 確認 mermaid-sample.png 的渲染器與設定；若為 ELK，評估 flowchart 的 ELK 排版

v: 調查（2026-10-12）：mermaid 11.17.2 預設 dagre 對 garden-network 圖反轉 Valve->Hub、Beds->Valve、Planner->Valve、Almanac->Tasks，與 Siren 完全相同（兩種函式庫 × 兩種節點順序皆同）。mermaid-sample.png 反轉 Seed->Planner、Almanac->Beds，且為直角圓角路由，非預設 dagre 可產生；推測 ELK 或其他版本／設定。先確認 mermaid.live 當時的版本與 layout 設定。實驗檔在 session scratchpad cycles/。

body: Conclusion: the orthogonal, rounded-corner routing in the reference picture is Mermaid 12's default layout. Mermaid 12.0.0 made ELK the default layout for flowchart, class, state and ER diagrams, and Mermaid 12.2.0 (measured in headless Chrome) draws them with ELK layered, orthogonal routes and rounded corners - not the dagre that Mermaid 11.17.2 used. Siren now does the same: all four graph-shaped kinds are laid out by ELK (elkjs 0.9.3, the version Mermaid 12.2.0 bundles) behind the shared layout core, and dagre is removed. Decisions: nook 01M4VA67H (ELK engine), 01M4VANRC (migration rules), 01M4VPWF5 (ADR-0001 amendment). The garden-network diagram's reversals now match Mermaid 12.2.0 (parity gates in the ELK migration spec 01M4V72SN).

Correction to the last sentence above: the garden-network diagram's reversal count does not match exactly. Measured with the parity script against Mermaid 12.2.0: garden-network.mmd reverses 11 edges in Siren and 9 in Mermaid (crossings 6 and 6, 0 edges through boxes in both); street-fair.mmd reverses 0 in both.
